	<description>Called when the bot thinks it is stuck.</description>

	<file line="106">gamemodes/base/entities/entities/base_nextbot/sv_nextbot.lua</file>

<example>
	<description>Kills the bot when getting stuck, using a new damageinfo object.</description>
	<code>
function ENT:OnStuck()

	local dmginfo = DamageInfo()
	dmginfo:SetAttacker( self )

	self:OnKilled( dmginfo )
	
end
